7. Continue gathering smooth stones while also obtaining additional iron ingots to build up our supply to a total of 5 iron ingots needed.
8. When all the iron ingots are gathered, move to create a blast furnace using 3 smooth stones and 1 furnace.
9. Use the blast furnace we crafted in the previous steps to craft 6 smooth stones slabs using the given crafting recipe (3 smooth stones).
10. After successfully crafting 5 iron ingots, start crafting the smooth stone slabs.

2. Gather 2 more smooth stones.

6. Get 1 more furnace to craft another blast furnace.
7. Gather the remaining ingredients to craft the blast furnace again.
8. Craft 3 smooth stones.
9. Combine 3 smooth stones and 1 furnace to craft 6 smooth stone slabs.
